title: 영상의 면이 없는 곳에 사전 정보가 틀린 결과가 남았다
expected_title: 사진은 반박했지만 따라갈 영상의 면이 없어 사전 정보가 틀린 채 남았다

photo.visibility_source: local supplied image-surface positions; outside occluders unavailable

metrics.result_denominator: roof_like & finite gt_p & centre projects inside the native crop

amendments.reason: Native FULL_OPENCV rational projection folds outside the calibrated field. Figure 1 diagnostic found 2636 crop-assigned centres outside the actual training-camera field, causing long false polygons.
amendments.change: For overlay and every crop statistic, require both the native crop and positive-depth calibrated PINHOLE image field. Reuse W/full exact pose and camera. Set bar x-axis bounds to include low-area categories.

amendments.reason: Independent viewers could locate result errors but the region names alone did not consistently communicate prior correctness. Explicitly define refinement/correction/preservation in the legend. Add required black hatching to inherited-wrong section bins.
amendments.changes: Legend labels only; section hatch when inherited-wrong area is at least half of the dominant inherited region in the bin.
